identity.method: automatic detector-seeded SAM 2 with backward crossing and single-player reacquisition checks

backwardChecks.reason: later observations do not match the earlier identity seam

observationChecks.method: exclusive detector/SAM association with immutable kit and motion gates

roleCheck.method: local uniform roles before roster seeding

identity.note: Fixed IDs and teams persist. Hidden poses are absent from observation data and filled explicitly for replay; backward corrections require a matching earlier identity seam.

jerseys.method: Apple Vision; agreement across at least three independent frames
jerseys.note: OCR estimates; conflicting or unreadable jerseys remain unknown.

snap_estimate.reason: sustained camera-compensated formation motion after a stationary interval

broadcast.source: automatically detected broadcast lines through registration; stated yards-to-go is unknown

ball.flight_projection: ground-plane projection of image sightings; altitude is not recovered
ball.note: A football in a wide broadcast shot is a few pixels and is behind somebody most of the play. Read measured_fraction AND travelled_yards before trusting any possession, passer or throw derived from this: a high detection rate on a static object is a confident wrong answer, and the generic sports-ball class finds broadcast graphics.

meta.automatic_pass_problem: no sufficiently supported release/arrival association from visible flight

registration.note: A homography can fit its own points perfectly and still place the field a hundred yards away. Read render_problems before believing a single coordinate in this file.
